panels.title: Sessioni
panels.description: Sum di claude_code.session.count. VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS sessioni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Sessioni distinte
panels.description: uniqExact su session.id. VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']) AS sessioni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Utenti distinti
panels.description: uniqExact su user.account_uuid (identità account, non user.id anonimo). VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(coalesce(nullIf(Attributes['user.account_uuid'], ''), Attributes['user.id'])) AS utenti
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Tempo attivo
panels.description: Sum di claude_code.active_time.total (secondi, esclude idle). VERIFICATO: dati presenti. Misura di attività/adozione, non di produttività: nessun ranking individuale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS secondi
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Sessioni nel tempo
panels.description: VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  sum(Value) AS sessioni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessioni per start_type
panels.description: fresh / resume / continue / agents_view. VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Attributes['start_type'] AS start_type,
  sum(Value) AS sessioni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY start_type
ORDER BY sessioni DESC

panels.title: Tempo attivo per tipo
panels.description: type=user (tastiera/lettura) vs type=cli (tool/risposte AI). VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Attributes['type'] AS tipo,
  sum(Value) AS secondi
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY tipo
ORDER BY secondi DESC

panels.title: Costo sessioni (USD)
panels.description: claude_code.cost.usage. Metrica documentata da Claude Code: oggi legge 0 perché le sessioni di prova non hanno completato chiamate API.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS costo_usd
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Token totali
panels.description: Sum di claude_code.token.usage (tutti i type). Misura di attività/adozione, non di produttività: nessun ranking individuale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS tokeni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Costo per modello
panels.description: Attributo model su claude_code.cost.usage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  Attributes['model'] AS modello,
  sum(Value) AS costo_usd
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, modello
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token per tipo
panels.description: type = input / output / cacheRead / cacheCreation (l'input esclude il prompt cache).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  Attributes['type'] AS tipo,
  sum(Value) AS tokeni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, tipo
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token per tipo, modello e query_source
panels.description: query_source = main / subagent / auxiliary: indica il tipo d'uso (sessione principale vs subagent).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Attributes['type'] AS tipo,
  Attributes['model'] AS modello,
  Attributes['query_source'] AS query_source,
  sum(Value) AS tokeni
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY tipo, modello, query_source
ORDER BY tokeni DESC

panels.title: Linee aggiunte
panels.description: claude_code.lines_of_code.count con type=added. Conta SOLO le righe scritte con gli strumenti di editing (Edit/Write/NotebookEdit): le modifiche fatte da shell (Bash/git/CI) non vengono conteggiate, quindi il valore resta 0 anche quando ci sono molti commit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS linee
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count'
  AND Attributes['type'] = 'added'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Linee rimosse
panels.description: claude_code.lines_of_code.count con type=removed. Stesso vincolo di 'Linee aggiunte': solo edit via Edit/Write/NotebookEdit, non le modifiche fatte da shell.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS linee
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count'
  AND Attributes['type'] = 'removed'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Commit creati
panels.description: claude_code.commit.count: solo i commit git creati da Claude Code. Escludo i commit fatti a mano e quelli del bot CI (github-actions).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS commit
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: PR creati
panels.description: claude_code.pull_request.count (PR/MR creati da Claude Code).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS pr
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.pull_request.count'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Edit accettati
panels.description: claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision con decision=accept. Solo gli strumenti Edit/Write/NotebookEdit: source=config indica auto-accept della modalità di permessi.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS accettati
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision'
  AND Attributes['decision'] = 'accept'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Edit rifiutati
panels.description: claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision con decision=reject: segnale di affidabilità dell'AI.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value) AS rifiutati
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision'
  AND Attributes['decision'] = 'reject'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Editing per tool e linguaggio
panels.description: Attributi tool_name (Edit/Write/NotebookEdit), decision, source, language. Resta vuoto se la sessione non ha usato gli strumenti di editing (es. solo Bash/Read).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Attributes['tool_name'] AS tool,
  Attributes['decision'] AS decisione,
  Attributes['language'] AS linguaggio,
  sum(Value) AS n
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY tool, decisione, linguaggio
ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Attività per repository
panels.description: Attributi vcs.* (richiesto OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=true e un remote 'origin' nella cartella). Attribuzione PER SESSIONE: il repo è quello in cui la sessione è stata avviata, letto all'avvio; i lavori su altri progetti fatti dalla stessa sessione restano accreditati qui. Colonne: sessioni distinte, costo USD, commit e PR creati da Claude Code per repository.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] AS repository,
  Attributes['vcs.owner.name'] AS owner,
  uniqExactIf(Attributes['session.id'], MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count') AS sessioni,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage') AS costo_usd,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count') AS commit,
  sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.pull_request.count') AS pr
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] != ''
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY repository, owner
ORDER BY costo_usd DESC

panels.title: Outcome · GitHub (commit e PR, import con scripts/import_github.sh)
Commit su branch di default
panels.description: Tutti i commit first-parent del branch di default (include quelli diretti, senza PR). Fonte: git log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS commit FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at)

panels.title: Di cui diretti su main
panels.description: Commit non riconducibili a PR/merge (euristica: niente '(#N)' nel subject e non merge). Questi non compaiono nelle statistiche PR.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(via_pr = 0) AS diretti FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at)

panels.title: Commit AI-assisted (%)
panels.description: Quota di commit con trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude. Indica uso, non qualità né produttività.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * avg(ai_assisted), 1) AS pct_ai FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at)

panels.title: PR mergeate
panels.description: Fonte: gh (ultimi periodi importati). Le PR non contano il lavoro committato direttamente su main.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS pr FROM otel.gh_pull_request FINAL WHERE merged_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_at)

panels.title: Costo USD per commit AI-assisted
panels.description: Costo Claude Code nel periodo, SOLO delle sessioni attribuite a repository presenti in gh_commit (esclude sessioni senza vcs.* o su altri repo), diviso i commit AI-assisted nel periodo. Rapporto aggregato grezzo, non attribuibile causalmente.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT sum(Value) FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage'
  AND Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] IN (SELECT splitByChar('/', repo)[2] FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL) AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
  / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL WHERE ai_assisted = 1 AND $__timeFilter(committed_at)), 0) AS usd_per_commit

panels.title: Cache hit token (%)
panels.description: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation): efficienza del prompt caching, non produttività.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'cacheRead') / nullIf(sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] IN ('input','cacheRead','cacheCreation')), 0), 1) AS pct_cache FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Commit nel tempo: AI-assisted vs manuali
panels.description: Commit per intervallo sul branch di default, divisi per trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude. Include i commit diretti su main.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(committed_at, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  countIf(ai_assisted = 1) AS commit_ai,
  countIf(ai_assisted = 0) AS commit_manuali
FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Adozione AI vs commit (correlazione grezza, non causale)
panels.description: Costo Claude Code (USD, asse sinistro, solo sessioni dei repo importati in gh_commit) e commit totali (asse destro) per intervallo. Serve a vedere se adozione e output si muovono insieme, NON a provare che l'una causi l'altro.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, sum(Value) AS costo_usd
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] IN (SELECT splitByChar('/', repo)[2] FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL) AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(committed_at, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, count() AS commit
FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Outcome per repository
panels.description: Aggregato per repository: commit sul branch di default (diretti vs via PR, AI-assisted), PR mergeate, e costo/sessioni Claude Code agganciati per nome del repo (vcs.repository.name = parte dopo '/'). Nessun dato per autore.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.repo AS repository,
  c.commit AS commit,
  c.diretti AS diretti_su_main,
  c.ai AS commit_ai,
  c.additions AS righe_aggiunte,
  coalesce(p.pr_mergeate, 0) AS pr_mergeate,
  coalesce(o.costo_usd, 0) AS costo_ai_usd,
  coalesce(o.sessioni, 0) AS sessioni_ai
FROM (
  SELECT repo, splitByChar('/', repo)[2] AS short, count() AS commit, countIf(via_pr = 0) AS diretti, countIf(ai_assisted = 1) AS ai, sum(additions) AS additions
  FROM otel.gh_commit FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(committed_at) GROUP BY repo
) AS c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT repo, count() AS pr_mergeate FROM otel.gh_pull_request FINAL
  WHERE merged_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_at) GROUP BY repo
) AS p ON p.repo = c.repo
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] AS short, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage') AS costo_usd,
    uniqExactIf(Attributes['session.id'], MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count') AS sessioni
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND short != '' GROUP BY short
) AS o ON o.short = c.short
ORDER BY commit DESC

panels.title: Eventi nel tempo
panels.description: Conteggio dei record in otel_logs (Body = nome evento).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  count() AS eventi
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top eventi
panels.description: Conteggio per nome evento (colonna Body di otel_logs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Body AS evento,
  count() AS n
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY evento
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Ultimi eventi
panels.description: Il contenuto dei prompt non è raccolto: l'attributo prompt è <REDACTED>.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Timestamp AS tempo,
  Body AS evento,
  LogAttributes['session.id'] AS sessione,
  LogAttributes['model'] AS modello
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Errori API
panels.description: Eventi claude_code.api_error: richieste fallite dopo i retry interni (segnale di qualità/frizione). VERIFICATO: dati presenti.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS errori
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_error'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

options.content:
### Cosa misura questa dashboard

**Telemetria Claude Code (OTel)**: adozione (sessioni, `start_type`, repo), costo e token, output (`commit`/`pull_request` creati da Claude Code), tool decision, errori API.

**Outcome da GitHub/git (riga *Outcome · GitHub*)**: commit sul branch di default, inclusi quelli **diretti su main**, e PR mergeate; flag AI-assisted dal trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude`. Import: `scripts/import_github.sh`.

**Non coperto** (vedi `docs/enterprise_fix.md`): cycle time per fase, WIP/aging, blocked time, throughput Done vs Cancelled (serve un tracker, es. Jira), review rounds/reopen, change failure rate, survey developer experience.

**Come leggerla**
- Sono aggregati per repository/tempo: nessun ranking individuale, token e linee di codice non sono proxy di produttività.
- Adozione ↔ outcome è una **correlazione grezza, non causale**: manca la stratificazione per tipo/size di lavoro.
- `vcs.*` è per sessione (repo di avvio). `AI-assisted` sui commit dipende dal trailer: commit AI senza trailer risultano manuali.
- Costo/token/commit/PR sono dati reali; `lines_of_code` e `code_edit_tool.decision` restano 0 finché le modifiche passano da `Bash` anziché `Edit`/`Write`.

title: Claude Code - Adozione, costo e outcome (POC)
